in_hebrew.name: Teddy
in_hebrew.meaning: שם נוצרי שפירושו Tender, gentle, affectionate
in_hebrew.long_meaning: Teddy הוא שם נוצרי עם משמעות רוחנית עמוקה בתרבות הנצרות. The name Teddy is derived from the English word 'teddy', which means 'teddy bear' or 'tender, gentle, affectionate'. This name was popularized in the late 19th century when President Theodore Roosevelt refused to shoot a bear cub during a hunting trip, choosing instead to name the bear 'Teddy'. The name became synonymous with kindness, love, and tenderness.
